name: Junko.
description_html:
Junko’s here! Time to purify Tarkov! jokes aside, this mod brings Junko the God of Purge Rage and or Fury/Purification to SPT 3.11. come up with any head cannon you want as to how she got there etc but yeah this mod is in a similar vein as my Mokou and Reisen mods.

The download instructions are the same as well grab the ID’s from the DB folder all files and very top when you open the files, go to profiles and go into yours. scroll down until you see your PMC’s body parts, insert the ID’s for each one (head upper etc) and then your good to go. it works in raid and in menu and hideout of course.

I do not have pics of her in raid but I will get them eventually. You can now play as my PFP ingame! bonus points if you get tagilla’s hammer working (somehow) and run around with angry Josh noises, it fits quite well.

I have one more mod planned character wise and then I am done for now with characters. I will focus on music mods for a bit after this as I have to update them for the music player mod which updated to 3.11. but with nothing to add, enjoy the mod!

(there’s a bit of odd texture work on her right sleeve robe wise no idea exactly how that happened but it’s not a deal breaker and it shouldn’t affect you in game.)

here have cool music as a gift: https://youtu.be/_hQq0t0EuLg?si=wOjaGzDliBOJXvJC (Demetori is the GOAT)
